details: ESCHOLARSHIP AGGREGATOR: All six campuses deposit ETDs (via ProQuest -> CDL ETD processor -> Merritt -> eScholarship within 24 h) into per-campus SERIES units under the campus unit: ucb_etd, ucla_etd, ucsd_etd, ucsb_etd, uci_etd, ucd_etd (also e.g. ucr_etd/ucsc_etd/ucsf_etd/ucm_etd exist but not tested). ACCESS TESTED 2026-10-13 with the survey UA "HistoriographyMetadataPilot/1.0": (1) GraphQL https://escholarship.org/graphql POST works without credentials; introspection enabled. Query: { unit(id:"ucb_etd"){ items(first:500, order:PUBLISHED_ASC, more:"<cursor>"){ total more nodes { id title published status embargoExpires contentLink subjects tags localIDs{id subScheme} authors(first:3){nodes{name}} contributors(first:5){nodes{name role}} } } } }. first:500 is the effective max (first:1000 -> HTTP 500). The default listing returns only PUBLISHED items; include:[EMBARGOED] returns ONLY the embargoed ones (with embargoExpires, contentLink null) - run both. Item fields: no degree/department/degree-level; contributors are only ADVISOR; localIDs give ProQuest DISSNUM URL; subjects = ProQuest subject terms (older UCSD records: LCSH incl. "UCSD Dissertations, Academic History. (Discipline)"). tags:["subject:History"] filter works but matches broadly (e.g. "History, Ancient", "Religion, History of"). Unit totals today: ucb_etd 13,458 published + 700 embargoed; ucla_etd 14,023 + 601; ucsd_etd 14,547 + 1,170; ucsb_etd 4,068 + 304; uci_etd 6,707 + 807; ucd_etd 3,689 + 876. Whole-unit harvest took 8-30 requests per campus. (2) OAI-PMH https://escholarship.org/oai works (Identify, ListMetadataFormats oai_dc/oclc_dc/marc21, GetRecord, ListIdentifiers). ListSets advertises only "everything", but set=<unit id> (e.g. set=ucb_etd) is accepted and returns that unit. Records carry dc:type etd, dc:identifier item URL and direct PDF URL, subjects, advisor as dc:contributor; no department/degree. (3) RATE LIMIT: after ~64 GraphQL POSTs in ~4.7 min (~2.5-4 s spacing, ~220 KB each) every request (GraphQL included) returned 403 CloudFront "Request blocked" for ~3.5 min, then recovered; at 7 s spacing ~90 more requests ran without a block. Budget <= ~8-10 requests/min (robots Crawl-delay: 4). (4) WEB AND PDF PATHS BLOCKED FOR THIS CLIENT: every GET to HTML/PDF paths returned 403 CloudFront "Request blocked" (not a JS challenge, no x-amzn-waf-action seen), from the very first request and independent of the rate limit: /robots.txt, /terms, /uc/ucb_etd, /uc/item/<id>, /siteMapIndex.xml, and PDFs /content/qtXXXX/qtXXXX.pdf (3 PDF probes on 2 items, 403 each). WebFetch (different client) could read robots.txt, so the block looks client/UA-based (AI-scraper protection; eScholarship help notice of 2026-09-15 reports AI-bot-driven outages, "verify you are human" interstitials, and that API/OAI-PMH may also be affected). We did not spoof a UA or try alternate hosts. PDF URLs are direct and predictable: contentLink = https://escholarship.org/content/qt<id>/qt<id>.pdf (also in OAI dc:identifier); embargoed items have contentLink null until expiry. Consequence: listing + metadata + open/embargo status are fully harvestable; PDF download needs either a sanctioned route (ask help@escholarship.org / CDL for allow-listing of an identified harvester UA, or a bulk export) or a different access path; do not plan on scraping /content/. ProQuest DISSNUM in localIDs lets you cross-walk to ProQuest for pre-deposit years. robots.txt (via WebFetch): Amazonbot Disallow /; * Disallow /search; Crawl-delay 4. Terms: API terms (Jan 2023) require a reasonable request rate, no numeric limit, public read API needs no credentials.
